_meta.note: Che approved apply 9 Aug night, amplifiers included. Adjust or remove per spot by editing this file.

gps_recheck.porridge: Applied interim {S:1.35} 16 Aug (read -27% low vs GSN, SC 1.97 vs 2.68 on the S swell). A gap this large may be a lineup-GPS shadow/inshore of the reef, not pure attenuation. RECHECK the lineup GPS; if repositioned, re-evaluate whether the amplify is still needed.
gps_recheck.te-henga-bethells: Applied {W:1.25} 16 Aug (read -20% low, SC 2.06 vs GSN 2.58 on the W/SW swell). GSN rates Bethells ~25% bigger than Piha (more exposed); our grid treats them equal. Likely genuine exposure, but glance at the lineup GPS to rule out an inshore placement.

_meta.reverted_2026_08_12: Batch-1 NI east coast sectors reverted at Che's call: fitted on the groundswell-row direction while the code keys off the dominant band, and hard 45deg bins with a 1.0 default produce slot-to-slot cliffs (Te Arai Sat 15 read 0.7/0.4/0.7). Superseded by the smooth directional-response work.

flat_factor_interim.note: Te Arai cluster on INTERIM flat factors in _metocean.FLAT_FACTORS (0.90/0.75/0.70). REVISIT: fit per-spot smooth curves once 2-3 more S/SW/E captures exist; flat under-reads on pure N.
